value.rationale: The source expressly proposes Frobenius row-ID selection as a tractable acceleration surrogate. The constructed globally preferred row choice forces unbounded raw-proposal overhead compared with another fixed row on the SAME nonsingular system and RHS, despite one accepted step for both. This isolates a genuine computational metric outside accepted-step convergence and identifies an immediately usable distinction between conditional sampling and rejection.
